text:
zoe: seeing repeated tiny-pod evictions in eu-west1c for the last 12m, dashboard shows pack/unpack churn
harry: same, eviction_rate ~6/min, lots of 1-GPU <2m jobs bouncing
zoe: quick probe shows some nodes missing the `nvidia-topo` label even though the image is the same
infra-oncall: ran this:
```
kubectl get nodes -l zone=eu-west1c -o=custom-columns=NODE:.metadata.name,BOOT:.status.conditions[-1].message,TOPO:.metadata.labels.nvidia-topo --no-headers
```
infra-oncall: sample:
```
node-eu-11  cloud-init: finished  none
node-eu-12  cloud-init: finished  nvlink
node-eu-13  cloud-init: timeout   none
```
harry: looks like cloud-init race on label script: if the network mount is slow the label step times out -> node joins without topology label -> scheduler places tiny pods there
cheng: later when a nvlink-requiring gang shows up we evict the tiny pods to consolidate, causing the repack spiral
descheduler-bot: descheduler canary initiated aggressive compaction in eu-west1c 4m ago
zoe: immediate actions: cordon the nodes missing `nvidia-topo`, pause the descheduler canary, and drain tiny pods into warmpool
infra-oncall: cordon+drain running on 2 nodes (~8 pods), ETA ~3m. Pausing descheduler canary now
harry: short-term fix: extend cloud-init label script retry and mark label step as blocking for node-ready, so nodes don't join unlabeled
cheng: medium-term: add a scheduler soft-preference `prefer-nvidia-topo` plus a 2m grace window before compaction evictions for pods <120s. Also add pack-weight decay for short-lived pods (multiplier 0.15)
zoe: also add an alert: `count(node_missing_label{label="nvidia-topo",zone="eu-west1c"}) > 1 AND sum(rate(kube_pod_evictions_total[5m])) by (zone) > 3` -> notify eng-platform oncall
infra-oncall: created alert https://go/alerts/RED-evict-label-drift-5900009999
harry: cost note: churn added ~1.9 node-hours and a handful of preemptible spinups, tagging cost team on the ticket
cheng: I'll open PRs: cloud-init retry, scheduler soft-pref + tiny-job weight, and an e2e that simulates delayed label propagation. Will include a slow-failback for mixed-gang jobs
zoe: filing INF ticket with `kubectl describe`, cloud-init logs, and the list of affected nodes; assigning to node-image and scheduler teams
infra-oncall: after reprovision we'll run parity check and rejoin nodes to the pool
zoe: thanks all, keeping thread live until nodes are fully reconciled :thumbsup:
